_comment: GENERATED by scripts/refresh-roles.mjs. Cold-start fallback for lib/roles.ts, used only when the Apps Script endpoint is unreachable or SHEET_WEBHOOK is unset. Re-run the script rather than editing by hand. Rows are the endpoint's own shape, so parseRoles reads them exactly as it reads a live response — a fallback the parser cannot understand is a fallback that fails the day it is needed.
